notes.title: Vote Now: DDLC Nomination for Steam Awards
notes.content:
[h3]We're proud to nominate [i]Doki Doki Literature Club Plus[/i] for the [b]Outstanding Story-Rich[/b] category of the 2021 Steam Awards![/h3]

In the development of DDLC and the expanded world of DDLC Plus, a driving goal of ours has been to deliver a uniquely meaning narrative experience to players.

We have been incredibly moved by your response to the Side Stories expansion of DDLC Plus, as a new narrative vehicle to more deeply understand and connect with your fellow club members.

It is in the spirit of this response that we have decided to nominate DDLC Plus for the Outstanding Story-Rich category of the 2021 Steam Awards. We invite you to share your experience with DDLC Plus and consider voting before December 2nd!

During a time of historically unprecedented challenges in game publishing, your dedication and continued support have made all the difference in the world in helping us launch this game. We want to extend our sincerest thanks for this continued support, and for the love you have shown this release.

[b]Click above to nominate DDLC Plus for the Outstanding Story-Rich Game of 2021![/b]

Thank you all for your time at the Literature Club this year!

notes.content:
[h1]Okay, everyone![/h1]


[h3]The time has finally come, and we’re proud to say that [i]Doki Doki Literature Club Plus[/i] is AVAILABLE NOW on PC and consoles! Enter a terrifying world of poetry and romance for [b]10% off on Steam[/b] for the first week![/h3]

[url=https://ddlc.plus/][u][b]Check out our website![/b][/u][/url]

[previewyoutube=soEwoP20Bw8;full][/previewyoutube]

Team Salvato and Serenity Forge have worked incredibly hard to bring you this expanded experience, and we couldn’t be more excited to see you all play your way through it. We recognize that [i]DDLC[/i] is a special game in different ways to different people; for some of you, it changed the way you think about games! We hope that [i]DDLC Plus[/i] brings the spirit of the original and more, leaving your perspective changed and giving you a deeper look at the bonds between the club members. There’s a lot to discover in your journeys with the Literature Club, so don’t be afraid to pursue different club members, write more poems, and share what you’ve learned with other players! We want to thank everyone for being so enthusiastic about [i]Doki Doki Literature Club[/i]. Throughout the years, you've shown us how passionate you've been about the game, what it means to you personally, and what it's inspired. Your dedication and support has been a driving force to see [i]DDLC Plus[/i] through, and we're so happy to finally share this mind-shattering experience with you.

Curious to know more about the inspirations and influences behind [i]DDLC Plus[/i]? Check out [url=https://youtu.be/rBu5V31pp58][u]Dan’s overview[/u][/url] of the new features coming to the game, as well as the people he worked with to make it happen!

If you spot a bug while playing [i]DDLC Plus[/i], please submit it to our [url=https://airtable.com/shrd4lEcAncgFuyoh][u]bug reporting form[/u][/url]! We’ll work to resolve the issue in a timely manner. We may reach out to you if we need further information regarding your report!

notes.title: Announcing Doki Doki Literature Club Plus!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! It's been a while, and we've been hard at work. In the past, I promised all of you that [i]DDLC[/i] would one day return with new content. Today, I'm following through on that promise with the announcement of [i]Doki Doki Literature Club Plus![/i]

[url=https://ddlc.plus][b]https://ddlc.plus[/b][/url]

[i]DDLC Plus[/i], coming June 30th, brings [i]Doki Doki Literature Club[/i] to a number of new platforms including Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox. In addition, it has hours of new content and lots of other cool features for you to enjoy. In this post, I'll go over some of the new features and content, but there are also some things that you'll want to discover for yourself when you play the game.

[i]DDLC Plus[/i] was created by Team Salvato and is being published digitally and physically by Serenity Forge. I also want to thank Serenity Forge for providing an incredible amount of development support from their team of skilled programmers - this release would not have been possible otherwise.

Okay, let's get into it!

[h2]6 New Side Stories[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710825/bb90f98da482ba609e4d5532f02772d2c03db911.jpg[/img]

I always felt like the characters in [i]DDLC[/i], the members of the Literature Club, deserved more of a space to get to know each other and kind of explore their interpersonal relationships. So for [i]DDLC Plus[/i], I wrote a new storyline that I call the Side Stories. The Side Stories take place outside the timeline of the original game, and they instead focus on how all of the club members went from first meeting each other to becoming close friends. I really wanted to create an environment where these characters, with very real and relatable insecurities, have to learn to overcome communication barriers, respect each other's needs, and reflect on themselves.

So in the Side Stories, you really get to watch the club members grow together, as people. I think that will be really meaningful to those of you who relate to the characters, or maybe even find yourselves in similar situations. I think this is a great time for some wholesome storytelling that can help keep us inspired to continue improving ourselves and our relationships with others.

There are six Side Stories in total—one for each pair of characters—so no matter who your favorite club member is, you'll have the chance to get to know her better than ever!

[h2]13 Additional Music Tracks[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710825/0d34a39adceef764ec944d8062cedd754c7404b2.jpg[/img]

The Side Stories also have a brand new soundtrack to go along with them. Music has always been an important part of [i]DDLC[/i], and really important to me personally as a part of playing video games. I love how music tracks sort of absorb all of the emotions you feel during the game, and how it all comes rushing back whenever you hear the songs again. I composed the original soundtrack with that experience in mind.

So for the Side Stories, I brought in a new composer, Nikki Kaelar, who shares the same passion and understanding of the special impact of video game music. Nikki and I have collaborated in the past before, but we worked more closely together than ever on the new tracks for [i]DDLC Plus[/i]. Some of Nikki’s songs have familiar catchy melodies, while others are totally new.

To help you enjoy all the music, [i]DDLC Plus[/i] has a built-in music player where you can easily make a custom playlist of your favorite songs, or of relaxing background music, or you can just loop one song forever with that seamless music loop you get in video games. The music player has 26 music tracks in total. I really hope you enjoy discovering the new music as you play the Side Stories, which will also unlock them in the music player.

The music player also includes two guest tracks, composed by Jason Hayes and Azuria Sky. I love how each of them brought along their own unique style—Jason Hayes, for instance, is best known for composing the World of Warcraft soundtrack. [i]DDLC[/i] really has reached farther than I ever could have imagined!

[h2]100+ Unlockable Pictures[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710825/d8628a96723d6ab210d2fa6d022d8971bbbe1038.jpg[/img]

Speaking of unlockables, another fun new feature is the picture gallery, where you can unlock pictures as you play the game. There are more than 100 unlockable pictures, like game artwork, wallpapers, and never-before-seen concept sketches of certain memorable scenes from the game. I think it's a fun way to encourage people to try new things in [i]DDLC[/i] and see if they can discover all the content. It's not easy to reach 100% content completion, but I bet if you and your friends share each of your own discoveries, you'd be able to do it together.

[h2]The [i]DDLC[/i] Experience[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710825/fba958c2836c2ee908af9a520c0111dbf3da1e46.jpg[/img]

For existing fans of [i]DDLC[/i], we made sure that there's more than enough new content to make [i]DDLC Plus[/i] feel really new and exciting. But another thing I kept in mind is how much the original [i]DDLC[/i] experience means to a lot of people. I know that there's always a concern about re-releases or special editions having a whole bunch of changes to them, or the original content being tampered with in some way. So, we thoughtfully included all the new content in a way that ensures that the main game, Doki Doki Literature Club, is as authentic and true to the original as possible.

There is one really good change to the original game, which is that all the artwork is in higher resolution now, with over twice the number of pixels. I hope it helps make the game more immersive, and maybe more scary as well. We’ve also added optional content warnings, so that you can choose to be warned in advance when approaching scenes that contain sensitive material.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

That's about it for the stuff I'm ready to talk about today. For everything else, I don’t want to spoil the fun of you discovering it yourself! But overall, I really wanted to make [i]DDLC Plus[/i] not only really special for existing fans, but also a fantastic and accessible way for new players to get in on the psychological horror experience.

I really put all of my heart into this game, along with everyone else who worked on it, and we're really grateful for the opportunity to share it with you. Doki Doki Literature Club Plus comes out on June 30th for PC and consoles. I hope that you give it a try and that you have a really enjoyable, meaningful, and terrifying time with the game.
